ticker: Lula da Silva wins fourth term as Brazil President
Serbia's student movement topples Vucic in historic vote
IMD issues red alert for severe cyclone near Andhra coast
SpaceX raises $40 billion in major debt deal
Microsoft backs away from UK data centre project

articles.headline: Lula da Silva reelected as Brazil President for fourth term
articles.brief: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has secured a historic fourth term as Brazil's president following a runoff vote. In his victory speech, Lula emphasized national sovereignty, declaring that Brazil is not anyone's backyard, while facing formidable economic challenges including mounting national debt.

articles.headline: Serbia's student movement ousts longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic
articles.brief: Serbia's student-backed opposition movement has successfully ousted longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic in a snap parliamentary election. The political upheaval follows nearly two years of intensive anti-corruption protests triggered by a deadly railway station canopy collapse in Novi Sad.

articles.headline: Severe cyclonic storm approaches Andhra Pradesh coast with heavy rains
articles.brief: The India Meteorological Department has issued red alerts for Odisha, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu as a severe cyclonic storm intensifies in the Bay of Bengal and moves toward the Andhra Pradesh coast. State authorities have stepped up disaster relief preparations and mobilized response teams.

articles.headline: SpaceX raises $40 billion in new debt financing deal
articles.brief: Elon Musk announced that aerospace company SpaceX has successfully raised $40 billion through a new debt deal. Alongside the funding announcement, Musk predicted an imminent shakeout within the neocloud sector as market pressures escalate.

articles.headline: Microsoft pulls out of UK data centre developer partnership
articles.brief: Microsoft has withdrawn from a major partnership with UK data centre developer Nscale after electricity companies warned that reliable power supplies would be delayed until 2030. The setback poses significant hurdles for expanding tech infrastructure in Essex.

articles.headline: Oil prices slip from six-month highs amid ongoing supply worries
articles.brief: Global oil prices pulled back from near six-month highs during Asian trading sessions, easing slightly despite persistent geopolitical supply concerns. Meanwhile, regional equity markets made a cautious start to the week.

articles.headline: India's private capital expenditure surges 39% to Rs 99.7 lakh crore
articles.brief: India's private capex pipeline has expanded significantly, surging 39% to reach Rs 99.7 lakh crore. However, financial reports warn of rising structural risks as investments remain heavily concentrated across a few specific states.

articles.headline: Borr Drilling rig sinks off Gabon, leaving one dead and four missing
articles.brief: A Borr Drilling offshore rig has sunk off the coast of Gabon in Central Africa. Emergency response teams confirmed that one crew member has died while four others remain missing as search and rescue operations continue.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia plans major crude storage facility in Singapore by 2027
articles.brief: Saudi Arabia has finalized strategic plans to store crude oil in Singapore starting in the second half of 2027. The move aims to secure a stronger foothold and efficient distribution hub within Asian energy markets.

articles.headline: Real Madrid defeat Barcelona at Camp Nou to narrow LaLiga gap
articles.brief: Real Madrid secured a crucial away victory against Barcelona at Camp Nou, successfully narrowing the points gap at the top of the LaLiga standings. The high-stakes El Clásico lived up to its billing with intense tactical battles.

articles.headline: Pakistan completes historic ODI run chase against England with record stand
articles.brief: Pakistan pulled off an improbable victory against England in an ODI fixture, successfully chasing down a target after slipping to 154-9. An unbroken, record-breaking last-wicket partnership sealed the dramatic comeback win.

articles.headline: Thousands protest Czech government's public media overhaul
articles.brief: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in the Czech Republic to protest the government's rushed public media overhaul. Protesters voiced strong opposition to legislative changes that threaten the editorial independence of state broadcasting institutions.

articles.headline: Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela after ten months in exile
articles.brief: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado has returned to the country after spending ten months in exile. While her return marks a significant political milestone, a definitive election timeline has not yet been established.

articles.headline: Delhi to restrict entry for non-BS6 commercial vehicles from November
articles.brief: Authorities in Delhi have announced a strict ban on entry for commercial and NCR vehicles failing to meet BS6 emission standards starting November 1. Over one million older vehicles registered in neighboring cities are expected to face travel restrictions.
